module.name: search-input
module.title: SearchInput
module.description: The SearchInput renderer and its options. The field lives inside its own GET form, so the query can be sent with no scripting at all.

ui.name: search-input
ui.summary: The debounced table search, inside its own GET form.
ui.guidance: It morphs Target and pushes the URL, so a search is shareable and the Back button works. The form is not decoration: a bare input has no submit path whatsoever, so with no scripting the query the user typed cannot leave the page. The form gives the browser the same job htmx does - send Name to GetURL - and any parameters GetURL already carries travel as hidden fields, because a native GET submit replaces the query string rather than adding to it. The submit control is visually hidden until focused: a permanently visible button beside a field that filters as you type says the live filtering does not work, and a button that only exists in JavaScript is one a keyboard or no-script user cannot reach.
